question: What will Micron Technology’s GAAP operating income be for fiscal Q1 2027?

calls.reasoning: Guidance (rev $61.5B±1.5B, GAAP GM 85.95%, GAAP opex $2.31B) implies GAAP OI ≈ $50.55B. Micron beat guide-implied OI by 30% in FQ3 and 6% in FQ4, but beats are shrinking as price increases slow (DRAM high-teens, NAND ~30% in FQ4 vs 60%+ prior), Q1 GM guided as FY27 low, and consensus ($61.7B rev, $38.23 EPS) sits on guidance. GAAP opex overshot massively in FQ4 ($3.3B vs $1.86B guided, incl. $500M patent charge) — main downside risk. Median ~$52.0B. Polymarket only has MU share-price contracts — no market on operating income; not used as anchor. Report due Dec 17 after close, before resolution.

calls.reasoning: Guidance: GAAP revenue $61.5B±1.5B, GAAP GM ~85.95%, GAAP opex ~$2.31B, which implies ~$50.55B GAAP operating income at the midpoint. Micron beat its revenue guide in all four FY26 quarters (9%, 28%, 24%, 8.5%, moderating), and in Q4 beat the guide-implied GAAP op income by ~7% despite an unguided $500M patent charge. Beats should shrink further: DRAM contract prices are rising only 10-15% QoQ, TrendForce said on Nov 25 that Chinese CSPs cut 2027 orders, and consensus revenue ($61.7-61.9B) sits barely above guide. Central case is ~$63B revenue at ~86.3% GM, giving ~$52B. Downside tail comes from possible GAAP one-off charges; upside tail from a FY26-style large beat. Markets: only Polymarket MU share-price contracts were found; they don't match this question, and no market prices operating income.
